gloss: stiff neck from sleeping; sleeping in an awkward position

definitions.gloss: stiff neck from sleeping; sleeping in an awkward position
definitions.explanation: neck pain or stiffness caused by sleeping in an improper posture

examples.japanese: {寝違|ねちが}いで{首|くび}が{痛|いた}い。
examples.english: My neck hurts from sleeping wrong.

examples.japanese: {昨日|きのう}{寝違|ねちが}いをして{首|くび}が{回|まわ}らない。
examples.english: I slept wrong yesterday and can't turn my neck.

examples.japanese: {変|へん}な{姿勢|しせい}で{寝|ね}たせいで{寝違|ねちが}いを{起|お}こした。
examples.english: I got a stiff neck because I slept in an odd position.

notes:
RELATED VERB:
{寝違|ねちが}える - to sleep in a bad position and get a stiff neck

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {寝違|ねちが}いを{起|お}こす - to get a stiff neck from sleeping
- {寝違|ねちが}いで{首|くび}が{動|うご}かない - can't move neck due to stiff neck

CAUSES:
- {枕|まくら}の{高|たか}さが{合|あ}わない - pillow height doesn't match
- {変|へん}な{姿勢|しせい}で{寝|ね}る - sleeping in an awkward position
- {疲労|ひろう} - fatigue
